summary: Senator Slotkin has committed to making D.C. statehood a top priority, while advocates continue to emphasize the need for statehood in response to federal involvement in District governance. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
